title: Pure Phantasm Spiral
summary: Normal Monster control built around Pacifis, the Phantasm City and Megalosmasher X. As long as you control no Effect Monsters, Pacifis punishes every opposing action with a Level 8 Phantasm Spiral Token and a Phantasm Spiral search, while the archetypal Traps fire straight from the hand.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pacifis, the Phantasm City (always treated as Umi) searches any Phantasm Spiral card once per turn when you Normal or Special Summon a Normal Monster, and Special Summons a Level 8 Phantasm Spiral Token (2000 ATK/DEF) whenever the opponent activates a card or effect while you control no Tokens.
Unexpected Dai Special Summons Megalosmasher X from the Deck onto an empty field, immediately triggering Pacifis to search before you use your Normal Summon.

Fish Sonar searches Megalosmasher X or Phantasm Spiral Dragon, and while Pacifis is on the field it also Special Summons a WATER Normal Monster from the Deck. Fossil Dig adds extra copies of Megalosmasher X.

summary.title: Opening: Pacifis + Unexpected Dai
steps: Activate Pacifis, the Phantasm City, then activate Unexpected Dai to Special Summon Megalosmasher X from the Deck.
Pacifis triggers on Megalosmasher X's summon to search Phantasm Spiral Battle or Phantasm Spiral Power, which stay in your hand as live handtraps while Umi is face-up.
Set Sea Stealth Attack, Skill Drain or a Counter Trap and pass; the first card or effect the opponent activates summons a Phantasm Spiral Token and triggers Pacifis again on their turn.

summary.title: Handtrap Traps & Sea Stealth Attack
points: Phantasm Spiral Battle destroys any card the opponent controls, and Phantasm Spiral Power negates an opposing Effect Monster and drops its ATK/DEF by 1000. Both activate from the hand while Umi is on the field and all monsters you control are Normal Monsters.

Sea Stealth Attack activates Pacifis from the hand or GY on activation, banishes a WATER monster until the End Phase to make your face-up Spells and Traps indestructible for the turn, and makes your Level 5 or higher WATER monsters (Phantasm Spiral Token and Phantasm Spiral Dragon) automatically destroy any monster they battle at the start of the Damage Step.

summary.title: Phantasm Spiral Dragon & Equips
summary.text: Phantasm Spiral Grip (+500 ATK and 1000 burn on battle kill), Phantasm Spiral Crash (piercing damage) and Phantasm Spiral Wave (once-per-turn battle protection and a forced discard) equip only to Normal Monsters. When an equipped monster battles or inflicts damage, the Equip Spell Special Summons Phantasm Spiral Dragon (2900 ATK) from the hand, Deck or GY and moves itself onto the Dragon.

summary.title: Counter Traps & Floodgates
points: Skill Drain negates every Effect Monster on the field while your Normal Monsters and Tokens keep their full stats and keep Pacifis and the Phantasm Spiral Traps live.
Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi negates a Spell, Trap or monster effect while you control a non-Effect Monster, and floats into Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon from the Extra Deck if destroyed while Set.
Champion's Vigilance negates a Summon or a Spell/Trap activation while you control a Level 8 Phantasm Spiral Token or Phantasm Spiral Dragon.

allow.Megalosmasher X: Level 4 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster (2000 ATK): Normal Summoning Megalosmasher X while Pacifis, the Phantasm City is on the field immediately triggers Pacifis to search Phantasm Spiral Battle or Phantasm Spiral Power!
allow.Fish Sonar: Normal Spell that adds any Level 7 or lower monster that mentions 'Umi' OR any WATER Normal Monster (Megalosmasher X!) from your Deck to your hand—and if 'Umi' is on the field, it also Special Summons 1 WATER Normal Monster directly from your Deck.
allow.Fossil Dig: Searches Level 4 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster Megalosmasher X from your Deck.
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Megalosmasher X directly from your Deck while you control no monsters—which immediately triggers Pacifis, the Phantasm City to search a Phantasm Spiral Trap!
allow.Skill Drain: Limited to 1 in TCG: Continuous Trap that negates all Effect Monsters on the field while leaving your Normal Monsters completely unaffected!
allow.Champion's Vigilance: Limited to 1 in TCG: Counter Trap that negates any Summon or Spell/Trap activation while you control a Level 7+ Normal Monster (your Level 8 Phantasm Spiral Token or Level 8 Phantasm Spiral Dragon!).
allow.Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi: Counter Trap that negates any Spell/Trap or monster effect while you control a face-up non-Effect Monster (Phantasm Spiral Token, Phantasm Spiral Dragon, or Megalosmasher X!).
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Pacifis, the Phantasm City.
allow.Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon: Level 8 Fusion monster cheated out from the Extra Deck if Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi is destroyed.

main: Pacifis, the Phantasm City

Core Field Spell (always treated as 'Umi'): if you summon a Normal Monster, adds 1 'Phantasm Spiral' card from Deck to hand; if opponent activates a card/effect while you control no Tokens, Special Summons 1 'Phantasm Spiral Token' (2000 ATK/DEF), which triggers its search!
Phantasm Spiral Dragon
Signature Level 8 WATER Wyrm Normal Monster (2900 ATK / 2900 DEF): summoned from hand, Deck, or GY whenever a monster equipped with a Phantasm Spiral Equip Spell battles or destroys a monster!
Megalosmasher X

Level 4 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster (2000 ATK): Normal or Special Summoning it while Pacifis is up immediately searches Phantasm Spiral Battle or Power, and keeps your Phantasm Spiral handtraps live!
Phantasm Spiral Battle

Signature Normal Trap: if all monsters you control are Normal Monsters, targets 1 card your opponent controls and destroys it; if 'Umi' is on the field, you can activate this card directly from your HAND!
Phantasm Spiral Power

Signature Normal Trap: if all monsters you control are Normal Monsters, targets 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, negates its effects, and reduces its ATK/DEF by 1000; can be activated directly from your HAND!
Phantasm Spiral Grip
Equip Spell: gives +500 ATK; when it destroys a monster by battle, Special Summons 'Phantasm Spiral Dragon' from hand, Deck, or GY, equips to it, and burns for 1000!
Phantasm Spiral Crash
Equip Spell: grants piercing damage; when it inflicts battle damage, Special Summons 'Phantasm Spiral Dragon' from hand, Deck, or GY and switches an opponent's monster to Defense Position!
Phantasm Spiral Wave
Equip Spell: prevents battle destruction once per turn; at the end of the Battle Phase, Special Summons 'Phantasm Spiral Dragon' and forces your opponent to discard 1 card!
Sea Stealth Attack

Signature Continuous Trap: activates 'Umi' on activation; banishes a WATER monster until End Phase to make face-up Spells/Traps indestructible, and Level 5+ WATER monsters automatically destroy opposing battling monsters!
Fish Sonar
Searches Megalosmasher X or Phantasm Spiral Dragon, and Special Summons a WATER Normal Monster directly from Deck if Pacifis is on the field!
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Megalosmasher X directly from your Deck while you control no monsters, immediately triggering Pacifis to search a Phantasm Spiral Trap!
Fossil Dig
Searches Megalosmasher X from your Deck.
Skill Drain
Limited to 1 in TCG: negates all Effect Monsters on the field while your Normal Monsters and Pacifis operate at 100% power!
Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi
Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect while you control a Normal Monster or Phantasm Spiral Token.
Champion's Vigilance
Limited to 1 in TCG: Counter Trap that negates any Summon or Spell/Trap while you control a Level 8 Phantasm Spiral Token or Phantasm Spiral Dragon!
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Pacifis, the Phantasm City.
extra: Summoned from the Extra Deck if a Set Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi is destroyed.
